qualification.reason: The document is a Request for Proposals (RFP) issued by AmeriCorps NCCC for organizations to apply for teams to perform community service projects. It includes application instructions, project focus areas, eligibility criteria, and partner responsibilities, indicating a procurement solicitation.

quotes.quote: 2026-2027 REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS
How Do You Apply for a Team?
Contact us by emailing NCCCProjectApplications@AmeriCorps.gov.
Qualifying organizations include: Nonprofit and faith-based organizations, Government entities (federal, state, and local), Public schools and universities, Native American tribal councils

findings.title: Eligible Applicant Organizations
findings.fact: Qualifying organizations include nonprofit and faith-based organizations, government entities, public schools and universities, and Native American tribal councils.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must confirm that their organization type falls within these categories to be eligible to apply.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify organizational status and eligibility before preparing the application.

quotes.quote: Qualifying organizations include: • Nonprofit and faith-based organizations • Government entities (federal, state, and local) • Public schools and universities • Native American tribal councils

findings.title: Application Submission Process
findings.fact: Applications are handled by Assistant Program Directors (APDs). To apply, determine project dates, contact NCCCProjectApplications@AmeriCorps.gov, follow instructions to submit a complete application by the due date.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must follow the specified process and ensure all required information is included in the application.
findings.action_recommendation: Contact the provided email for detailed instructions and submit a complete application before the deadline.

quotes.quote: Applications are handled by Assistant Program Directors (APDs). To apply: • Determine the project dates when you’d like to receive a team. • Contact us by emailing NCCCProjectApplications@AmeriCorps.gov. • Follow the instructions to submit a complete application by the due date.

findings.title: Project Dates and Notification Timeline
findings.fact: Project dates are subject to change and include travel time. Applicants are notified of award approximately six weeks prior to the project start date.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must plan for potential date changes and be prepared for a notification timeline of six weeks before project start.
findings.action_recommendation: Consider flexibility in scheduling and prepare for possible adjustments to project dates.

quotes.quote: *Project dates are subject to change and INCLUDE a team’s travel time to and from the project.
We will notify applicants of award approximately six weeks prior to the project start date.

findings.title: Partner Responsibilities
findings.fact: Partner organizations must provide at least 40 hours per week of enriching service, daily technical supervision, all project materials, tools, protective gear, work permits, housing with full kitchen and bathroom, and service-learning education.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must be prepared to commit significant resources and support to the team, including housing and supervision.
findings.action_recommendation: Assess capacity to meet these obligations and include them in the application.

quotes.quote: What Do Partner Organizations Provide? • At least 40 hours per week of enriching service that meets the needs named in your application • A broad range of different types of service experiences for the team • Daily technical supervision for the team, including on-the-job training • Orientation to the organization and community • All project materials, tools, and protective gear • Any work permits required to complete service • Service-learning education on community needs and deeper issues related to the project • Housing for the team, to include a full kitchen, full bathroom with showers, cleaning supplies, and toilet paper for the duration of the project
